``` {r load_library, include=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(here)
```

# Configuration

``` {r setup}
# File's path (change if necessary)
file_path <- here("Spreadsheets", "Metiloma_CP_PlanilhaINCA.xlsx") # The order is Folder name + File name
selected_col <- "Estadiamento" # Choose what column you want selected
chip_cols <- 5 # How many columns will your chip have?
chip_rows <- 8 # How many rows will your chip have?
cleaning_staging_column <- TRUE
cleaning_sex_column <- FALSE
```

# Data Loading and Cleaning

``` {r data_loading}
Data <- read_excel(file_path) # Reads the file, if it is a .csv file change read_excel to read.csv
Data$Target <- Data[[selected_col]] # Creates a column named target that copies everthing that is in the selected_col
  if (cleaning_staging_column == TRUE) {
    Data <- Data %>%
    mutate (
      Target = str_extract(Target, regex("p\\s*t\\s*\\d[a-z]?", ignore_case = TRUE)), # Extracts only the staging id, so if there's pt 1 a (subepc...), it only extract pt1a
      Target = str_remove_all(Target, "\\s"), # Removes all spaces
      Target = str_to_upper(Target) # Makes all letters uppercase
)

} else if (cleaning_sex_column == TRUE) {
  Data <- Data %>% 
    mutate(
  Target = str_extract(Target, regex("^[mf]", ignore_case = TRUE)), # Extracts nly the first letter of female and male
  Target = str_to_upper(Target) # Makes all letters uppercase
)
}
table(Data$Target)
```
